description_en: A rectangular cane handbag with three fabric-lined compartments joined by pleated leather gussets and rigid handles. Canonical front: a flat rectangular woven plate and small central clasp. Side view: three separate folded gussets and handle pivots. Rear view: a second flat woven plate with a leather pocket opening. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: A rectangular cane handbag with three fabric-lined compartments joined by pleated leather gussets and rigid handles. Canonical front: a flat rectangular woven plate and small central clasp. Side view: three separate folded gussets and handle pivots. Rear view: a second flat woven plate with a leather pocket opening. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.. Style Sang trọng: refined precise proportions and minimal plain hardware. Relative size generous within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: open square lattice made from wider flat strips. Finish: deep walnut-brown dye with visible fiber grain. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact straight-on FRONT ELEVATION at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature, level with product center. No three-quarter or overhead angle. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
